name: Iowa
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A state that was once among the largest wine producers, until Prohibition. Very warm summer days and extremely cold winter nights are hard on vines, so most vineyards focus on French hybrid and native American grapes, led by Marquette, Frontenac and La Crosse. Loess Hills District is its western AVA.
